dialog.openFolder: Choose a project folder to add to Trellis

quit.title: Claude is still running
quit.detail: Quitting now ends {{count}} running Claude session(s). The conversation stays in Claude Code, so you can continue it later.

onboarding.title: Welcome to Trellis
onboarding.subtitle: Keep the intent of your project in view while you work with AI.
onboarding.languageHint: Used for the app. You can change it later in Settings.
onboarding.claudeHelp: Install Claude Code, then check again. If it is installed but not found, set its path in Settings → Claude Code after you start.
onboarding.gitHelp: Trellis needs git to track changes. Install git, then check again.
onboarding.shellEnvWarn: Could not read your login shell environment. Some commands may not be found.
onboarding.projectHint: Add a folder you want to work on with Claude. You can also skip this and add one later.
onboarding.permissionHint: You can choose each time Claude starts; this only sets what is preselected.

projects.title: Projects
projects.emptyHint: Add a folder you want to work on with Claude.
projects.confirmRemove: Remove {{name}} from the list? The files in the folder stay where they are.

terminal.noProjectBody: Pick a project on the left or add a folder, and Claude Code starts here.
terminal.notFoundBody: Make sure Claude Code is installed. If it is and still not found, set its path in Settings.
terminal.startBody: Choose how Claude asks for permission, then continue your last conversation or start a new one.
terminal.confirmClose: Claude is running in this tab. Closing the tab ends it; the conversation stays in Claude Code so you can continue it later.

intent.title: Intent
intent.empty: Before you start, write down what you want to do and what must not break. Later it answers "why did we do this?"
intent.hint: Write it yourself, briefly — that is the point. One "must not" per line can become an invariant in the behavior spec.
intent.noClaude: No running Claude session to paste into. Your intent was saved.
intent.goalPlaceholder: Lock the account for 30 minutes after 5 failed logins
intent.mustNotPlaceholder:
Do not change the session token format
Do not touch payment amount calculation
intent.predictedHint: After the work, Trellis compares this with what actually changed.
intent.invariantsSent_one: Sent {{count}} item to the Behavior tab. Review and apply it there.
intent.invariantsSent_other: Sent {{count}} items to the Behavior tab. Review and apply them there.

inspector.noProject: Open a project to see its intent, timeline, changes, decisions and health here.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.emptyHint: Ask Claude for something in the terminal and each request shows up here as a turn.

changes.title: Changes
changes.fallback: Claude has not been started since Trellis opened, so there is no baseline yet; this compares against the last commit. Counting starts when you start Claude.
changes.emptyHead: Nothing changed since the last commit.
changes.notRepoHint: Trellis computes changes with git. Start git in this folder to track them.
changes.gitMissing: git was not found. Install git and try again.

decisions.title: Decisions
decisions.disabled: Decisions are turned off for this project
decisions.missing: The decisions folder ({{dir}}) does not exist
decisions.missingHint: Recording a decision creates this folder. If you already keep decisions elsewhere, point the setting there so there is only one place.
decisions.noPending: Each time Claude finishes, Trellis looks for choices that are hard to reverse or shape future work, and puts them here.
decisions.analysisOff: Turn analysis is off for this project. Only changes in risk areas show up here. You can turn it on in Settings.
decisions.reasonPlaceholder: Why was it done this way? Write a line or two yourself.
decisions.noRecordFiles: The decision records folder is off, so this stays inside Trellis only.
decisions.useGuess: Record the AI's guess as the reason
decisions.usage_one: Turn analysis ran {{count}} time in this project
decisions.usage_other: Turn analysis ran {{count}} times in this project

health.title: Health
health.truncated: Too many files; only part of the project was measured.
health.trendNone: After a day, this shows what got worse since the last snapshot.
health.driftTitle: Paths in docs that do not exist · {{count}}
health.driftHint: Instruction files, the README or specs mention paths that are gone. Update the docs or point them to where the code moved.

settings.title: Settings
settings.notificationsHint: Notify when Claude finishes or waits for you while Trellis is in the background.
settings.dataNote: Settings, the project list and event records are stored only on this computer.
settings.claudePathHint: Leave empty to search PATH and the default install locations.
settings.extraArgsHint: Added when launching claude. Example: --model opus
settings.defaultModeHint: Starts a new conversation when there is nothing to continue.
settings.editorKindHint: Trellis has no editor of its own; files open in the app you choose here. Only editors found on this computer are listed.
settings.customPathHint: The file path is passed as the first argument.
settings.fontFamilyHint: Leave empty for the default monospace font.
settings.decisionsDirHint: Relative to the project. Leave empty to turn the decisions panel off — do that if the project already records decisions another way, so they are not kept twice.
settings.recordLanguageHint: Language for records Trellis writes into this project.
settings.onProjectOpenHint: "Ask" shows a card to choose permissions and continue/new; "Start" launches right away with the defaults.
settings.gpuHint: Faster with heavy output, but on some setups the screen may stop repainting. Turn it off if typed text does not appear.
settings.composerHint: A regular text box under Claude tabs. Text is finished by your input method and sent at once, avoiding Claude Code splitting Korean into jamo after switching languages.
settings.specsDirHint: Markdown folder with behaviors and invariants per feature area. Leave empty to not use behavior specs.
settings.analysisEnabledHint: Each time Claude finishes, Trellis looks for decisions and behavior changes and asks you about them. This costs one extra Claude call per turn (subscription usage).
settings.riskAreasHint: Changes to files matching these patterns always ask for a human check, with or without analysis. One per line.
settings.analysisModelHint: Model used for turn analysis. sonnet balances accuracy and speed; haiku is faster and lighter.
settings.guard: Check at the end of work
settings.guardHint: When Claude finishes, Trellis checks the structure rules (only violations this work introduced) and runs the check command; if something fails, Claude is sent back to fix it. At most once per turn.
settings.checkCommandHint: Runs in the project folder during the end-of-work check (e.g. npm test, pytest -q). Leave empty for structure rules only. Stops after 100 seconds.

toast.gitInitFailed: Could not create a git repository. {{message}}

launch.continueBusy: Claude is running in another tab, so "Continue" is unavailable — two tabs on one conversation would tangle it. Start a new conversation.

claude-default.label: Follow Claude settings
claude-default.hint: Trellis passes no permission flag; ~/.claude/settings.json and Claude Code defaults decide.

manual.label: Ask every time (manual)
manual.hint: Asks before every file edit and command.

acceptEdits.label: Auto-accept edits (acceptEdits)
acceptEdits.hint: File edits go through; commands still ask.

auto.label: Auto (auto)
auto.hint: Claude Code judges the risk and only asks when needed.

plan.label: Plan only (plan)
plan.hint: Plans without changing files; acts only after you approve.

bypass.label: Skip all checks (dangerously-skip-permissions)
bypass.hint: Runs everything without asking. Use only in folders you trust, when you can review the result.

editors.title: Open files with which editor?
editors.description: {{path}} — you will not be asked again.
editors.systemHint: The app associated with the file type
editors.revealHint: Show where the file is instead of opening it
editors.changeLater: You can change this anytime in Settings → Editor.

composer.hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line · paste images, drop files · Esc when empty interrupts Claude · click the terminal for menus
composer.images_one: Attached {{count}} image to Claude’s input. It goes with your message.
composer.images_other: Attached {{count}} images to Claude’s input. They go with your message.

specs.title: Behavior
specs.noPending: When Claude's work changes what users see, it shows up here. Applied changes go into the behavior spec files.
specs.disabled: The behavior spec folder is off for this project
specs.emptyHint: Applying a behavior change creates one file per feature area in {{dir}}.
specs.testHint: Mention an item id such as B-001 in a test name or body to link it here.

rules.title: Structure rules
rules.configError: Could not read the rules file; using defaults: {{message}}
rules.cleanSinceBaseline: No new violations since the baseline.
rules.freezeHint: Freeze today's violations as known debt; from then on only new ones show.
rules.freezeConfirm: Record the {{count}} current violations as the baseline in .trellis/baseline.json? This adds a file to the repository; commit it to share with the team.
rules.folderSize: {{path}}/: {{size}} code files (limit {{limit}}). Please group them into subfolders.
rules.duplicate: {{path}} and {{target}} share about {{size}} identical lines. Please keep one copy.
rules.boundary: {{path}} → {{target}}: this dependency is not allowed by the rules.

guard.intro: [Trellis check] This work introduced problems. Please fix them before finishing. Do not edit the rules (.trellis/) or the baseline; if a rule must change, ask the human.
guard.checkFailed: The check command `{{command}}` failed. End of its output:

templates.title: Start rules and intent docs
templates.description: Creates structure rules and starter instruction, decision and spec docs. Existing files are never touched.
templates.note: The files stay in the repository. Edit them and commit to share with your team.
